beginner.headline: Today (Sun Oct 11): conditional for beginners. Long-period south swell peaks today, below advisory; Canoes 2–3 ft+ (thigh to waist, Surfline) with 18 s S sets that can run well above the average. ENE trades about 9–12 kt, gusting to about 18 kt, cross-offshore. Best 7–10 AM on the falling tide.
beginner.recommendation: Plan for 7–10 AM: tide falling from the 4:28 AM high (2.1 ft; Surfline showed about 1.7 ft early) with more water over the reef than at the 10:57 AM low (0.5 ft), and trades at the light end early (NWS discussion: winds east 5–10 mph overnight; Surfline 9 kt ENE). Watch several full set cycles first: 17–18 s sets at the swell peak can be much bigger than the 2–3 ft average and push further inside. One student or a small group of strong adults; several students or children only if sets stay manageable and drift is low. Brown, gray or cloudy water at Canoes or toward the Kūhiō drains / Ala Wai side ends it.
